title: Two Clocks. One Decision. | AMORDER Daily Short
topic: Pause when market-clock and quote timestamps cannot be reconciled

format.visual_engine: Blender Eevee PBR original 3D scenes with softbox lighting and depth of field
format.post_production: FFmpeg controlled camera movement, fades, burned captions and sound mastering

creative_direction.style: Ultra-realistic cinematic product-film language: dark graphite studio, precision metal and glass-like PBR surfaces, softbox reflections, restrained cyan and warm amber accents, spacious editorial typography and deliberate motion.
creative_direction.voiceover_direction: Clear, calm, confident natural English narration for a broad international audience; moderate pace and natural pauses.
creative_direction.overlay_direction: One concise headline and one supporting line per scene. Keep typography large, minimal and inside mobile safe areas.

scenes.title: TWO CLOCKS. ONE DECISION.
scenes.narration: Two clocks disagree? Pause. The paper cycle stopped because the time references could not be reconciled.

scenes.title: TIME IS PART OF THE DATA
scenes.overlay: Every quote needs a reliable timestamp.
scenes.narration: A price without a trustworthy timestamp is incomplete evidence.

scenes.title: CHECK COMPLETED BARS
scenes.overlay: A partial candle is not final evidence.
scenes.narration: Check the session and use completed bars, never a candle still forming.

scenes.title: FILTERS MUST AGREE
scenes.narration: A ranking cannot override weak liquidity, wide spreads or missing confirmation.

scenes.title: NO TRADE IS VALID
scenes.overlay: Do not guess to keep moving.
scenes.narration: If the data conflicts, record the reason and wait.

scenes.title: VERIFY. THEN DECIDE.
scenes.narration: AMORDER. Verify the clock, verify the data, then decide. Paper-trading education only; not live-money performance; not investment advice; no guaranteed returns.
